model.about: Google Gemma 4, mixture of experts (26B, 4B active), BF16 as released. Apache-2.0. October retest: vLLM 0.31.0, Gemma tool/reasoning parsers and tool chat template, explicit non-thinking requests, no free JSON whitespace. September's vLLM 0.30.0 runs repeated tokens under strict JSON; those results retain their original configuration. Compatibility of this configuration must be checked with --quick before a full run.

SELECT 
    d.DSPLY_NM, 
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON t.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
  j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
  COUNT(a.ALRT_ID) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
    AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS default_client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT = (
    SELECT MAX(d2.CAL_DT)
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f2
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON f2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
    WHERE d2.CAL_DT <= '2025-08-31'
      AND d2.CAL_DT >= '2025-08-01'
  )
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
  t3.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG t3
  ON t1.CMPLT_CTG_K = t3.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t2
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t2.DT_K
WHERE t2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t3.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT = (
      SELECT MAX(CAL_DT) 
      FROM bank_dwh.D_DT 
      WHERE MTH_NM = 'August' 
        AND CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT 
    f.QUOT_CCY_CD1 AS quote_currency, 
    f.BS_CCY_CD1 AS base_currency, 
    AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.QUOT_CCY_CD1, f.BS_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.QUOT_CCY_CD1, f.BS_CCY_CD1

SELECT
    m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  ACCT_TYP_CD1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS opened_account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
    AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY
    br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY
    atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT 
    AVG(f.BS_BAL_AMT) as avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT 
    AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
WHERE QUOT_CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20251201 AND 20251231;

SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS num_customers_no_txn
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
);

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
WHERE BUS_DT_K >= 20250101 
  AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
    AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  SUM(t.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM

SELECT 
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt,
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1

SELECT
  j.DSPLY_NM,
  COUNT(a.ALRT_ID) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM

SELECT
  COUNT(f.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT 
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS transaction_year, 
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM,
    SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON f.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE f.BUS_DT_K = 20251231
  AND p.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH BranchCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
),
RankedBranches AS (
    SELECT 
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_txn_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC) as rnk
    FROM BranchCounts
)
SELECT 
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_count
FROM RankedBranches
WHERE rnk = 1;

SELECT 
    m.MRCH_CTG_CD1, 
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON f.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K AND m.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    d.BUS_ID, 
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY d.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  CCY_CD1,
  SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
GROUP BY
  CCY_CD1;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
AND w.CUST_K IN (
    SELECT a.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT 
    LEFT(CAST(BUS_DT_K AS TEXT), 4) AS year, 
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF 
WHERE CAST(BUS_DT_K AS TEXT) LIKE '2024%' 
   OR CAST(BUS_DT_K AS TEXT) LIKE '2025%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
SELECT NULL

WITH customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT 
        c.BUS_ID,
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        SUM(t.BS_AMT) AS total_ltv
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
    WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    AVG(total_ltv) AS avg_customer_lifetime_value
FROM customer_ltv
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

answers.sql: SELECT DISTINCT DSPLY_NM FROM bank_dwh.D_BR WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND) AS weekend_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT d.IS_WKND) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ACCT_K) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D t1
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D t2
    ON t1.ACCT_K = t2.ACCT_K
WHERE t1.BUS_DT_K = 20250630
  AND t2.BUS_DT_K = 20251231
  AND t1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT > 0
  AND t2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < (t1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.9)

SELECT 
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    AVG(f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.RSLTN_AT >= '2025-01-01' 
  AND f.RSLTN_AT < '2026-01-01'
  AND f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT sub.BUS_ID)
FROM (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) AS PREV_CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        IS_CURR
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
) sub
WHERE sub.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND sub.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> sub.PREV_CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  AND sub.PREV_CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
  ON c.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE
  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt2
      ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt2.DT_K
    WHERE
      w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND dt2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT t1.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    LN_ID,
    DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20240630
) AS t1
JOIN (
  SELECT
    LN_ID,
    DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250630
) AS t2
  ON t1.LN_ID = t2.LN_ID
WHERE t1.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND t2.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT 
    CCY_CD1,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE BUS_DT_K >= 20250101 AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231
GROUP BY CCY_CD1;

WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.CAL_YR_NBR,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT
    ((y2.txn_count - y1.txn_count)::FLOAT / y1.txn_count) * 100 AS growth_percentage
FROM yearly_counts y1
JOIN yearly_counts y2 ON y1.CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 AND y2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_days_of_month AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(CAST(BUS_DT_K AS TEXT), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS month_num,
        MAX(BUS_DT_K) AS last_bus_dt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K >= 20250101 AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    l.month_num,
    SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_account_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN last_days_of_month l ON f.BUS_DT_K = l.last_bus_dt
GROUP BY l.month_num
ORDER BY l.month_num;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT >= '2025-01-01' 
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT <= '2025-12-31'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' BETWEEN EFF_FRM_DT AND COALESCE(EFF_TO_DT, '9999-12-31')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
        c.BUS_ID, 
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE f.BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
      AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
),
RankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
        BUS_ID, 
        total_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY total_amount DESC) as rnk
    FROM CustomerTotals
)
SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1, 
    BUS_ID, 
    total_amount
FROM RankedCustomers
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1, total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    f.CCY_CD1,
    (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER()) AS share_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY share_percentage DESC;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  MTH_NBR,
  wire_transfer_count,
  SUM(wire_transfer_count) OVER (ORDER BY MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN T.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN T.ORGNL_AMT
            ELSE T.ORGNL_AMT / R.MID_RT
        END
    ) AS total_wire_transfer_amount_eur
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS T
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS D
    ON T.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS R
    ON T.BUS_DT_K = R.BUS_DT_K
    AND T.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = R.QUOT_CCY_CD1
    AND R.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
WHERE D.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT 
    month_num,
    share_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(CAST(BUS_DT_K AS TEXT), 'YYYYMMDD')) as month_num,
        ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*)::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) as share_percentage
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
    WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
    GROUP BY 1
) t
ORDER BY share_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(t.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM

SELECT

  COUNT(t1.ACCT_K) AS account_count

  SELECT
    ACCT_K,

  ON t1.ACCT_K = t2.ACCT_K
WHERE t1.bal_dec < (t2.bal_jun * 0.9);

SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)

loans_june_2025 AS (

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1

WITH txn_counts AS (

    GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR

        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(BUS_DT_K::TEXT, 'YYYYMMDD')) AS month_num,
        MAX(BUS_DT_K) AS max_bus_dt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID)

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count

        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,

RankedCustomers AS (

SELECT

WHERE BUS_DT_K >= 20250101 AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231
GROUP BY
  CCY_CD1;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.MTH_NBR,
        COUNT(*) AS monthly_transfers
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.BS_CCY_CD1, f.QUOT_CCY_CD1

SELECT

SELECT
  ACCT_TYP_CD1,

GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM,
    COUNT(atm.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm

SELECT

FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT 
    AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
WHERE QUOT_CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND BUS_DT_K >= 20251201 
  AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR,
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_without_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.BUS_ID NOT IN (
    SELECT
      cust.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON txn.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
WHERE ATHRZ_AT >= '2025-01-01' AND ATHRZ_AT < '2026-01-01'

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    SUM(txn.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL AS ch

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
    ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM

SELECT
  SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT 
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(a.ALRT_ID) AS high_severity_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_severity_alert_count DESC;

SELECT
  COUNT(f.LN_ID) AS num_loans
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT 
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR, 
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL AS ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE ch.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
  d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
  SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
  AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE
  c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND f.INTTD_AT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND f.INTTD_AT < '2026-01-01';

WITH branch_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        b.RGN_CD1, 
        b.DSPLY_NM, 
        COUNT(*) as txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
    WHERE b.IS_CURR = TRUE
      AND f.BUS_DT_K >= 20250101 
      AND f.BUS_DT_K <= 20251231
    GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked_branches AS (
    SELECT 
        RGN_CD1, 
        DSPLY_NM, 
        txn_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY RGN_CD1 ORDER BY txn_count DESC) as rank
    FROM branch_counts
)
SELECT 
    RGN_CD1, 
    DSPLY_NM, 
    txn_count
FROM ranked_branches
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY RGN_CD1;

SELECT 
    m.MRCH_CTG_CD1,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_auth_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH m ON f.MRCH_K = m.MRCH_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND m.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY m.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_auth_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    c.BUS_ID, 
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency_code, 
    SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
GROUP BY STLM_CCY_CD1

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON a.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE BUS_DT_K >= 20250101
  AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231;

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
  COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;
SELECT NULL

SELECT 
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
    AVG(f.RPRTN_BAL_AMT) AS avg_customer_value
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON c.CUST_K = f.CUST_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT branch_name FROM bank_dwh.dim_branch;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = TRUE) AS weekend_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = FALSE) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT
        ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BUS_DT_K = 20250630 THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_june,
        MAX(CASE WHEN BUS_DT_K = 20251231 THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_dec
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
    WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (20250630, 20251231)
    GROUP BY ACCT_K
) AS comparisons
WHERE bal_june IS NOT NULL 
  AND bal_dec IS NOT NULL 
  AND bal_dec < (bal_june * 0.9)

SELECT 
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    AVG(f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND f.RSLTN_AT >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND f.RSLTN_AT < '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID)
FROM (
  SELECT
    BUS_ID,
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) AS PREV_CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    IS_CURR
  FROM bank_dwh.d_cust
) sub
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> PREV_CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  AND PREV_CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
    ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE
    d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY
    c.BUS_ID
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4
) AS customers_with_all_quarters;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS f
  ON c.CUST_K = f.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.BUS_ID NOT IN (
    SELECT
      c2.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c2
    JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
      ON c2.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d2
      ON w.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
    WHERE
      d2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND c2.IS_CURR = TRUE
  );

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT t1.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS t1
JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS t2
  ON t1.LN_ID = t2.LN_ID
WHERE t1.BUS_DT_K = 20240630
  AND t1.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND t2.BUS_DT_K = 20250630
  AND t2.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT 
    CCY_CD1,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
WHERE BUS_DT_K >= 20250101 AND BUS_DT_K <= 20251231
GROUP BY CCY_CD1;

WITH txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.CAL_YR_NBR AS txn_year,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
    WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(((curr.txn_count - prev.txn_count) * 100.0 / prev.txn_count), 1) AS growth_percentage
FROM txn_counts prev
JOIN txn_counts curr ON curr.txn_year = prev.txn_year + 1
WHERE prev.txn_year = 2024 AND curr.txn_year = 2025;

WITH last_days_of_month AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(f.BUS_DT_K) as last_bus_dt_k
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_MTH_CD1
)
SELECT 
    d.MTH_NBR,
    SUM(f.BS_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN last_days_of_month l ON f.BUS_DT_K = l.last_bus_dt_k
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT <= '2025-12-31'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' BETWEEN EFF_FRM_DT AND COALESCE(EFF_TO_DT, '9999-12-31')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        c.BUS_ID,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) as total_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE f.BUS_DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
      AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        BUS_ID,
        total_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY total_amount DESC) as rank
    FROM customer_totals
)
SELECT 
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    BUS_ID,
    total_amount
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1, rank;

SELECT 
    f.CCY_CD1,
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS num_wire_transfers,
    SUM(COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;
